title: agriculture farm
description: Facilitates the harvesting of agricultural crops
body:
Everyone's probably sick of using the residents. Long walks, sleep at night, and trubuyut sapolneniya inventory for normal operation. I suggest you remove the dwellers and use this datapack. A couple of manipulations and your farm works in automatic mode. And just need to throw “water bucket” in the “composter”, and it will bring you a lot of resources from the farm.

Works a 9x9 with a composter in the center!!!
Check out the gallery!!!

Operating principle:[https://youtu.be/FfrI52_qUrs](https://youtu.be/FfrI52_qUrs)
